Adventure = }} }} }} |}}|}} == Description == Lists all adventures, events, raids, and stories that rewards the specific item. In special cases this template also lists NPCs, e.g. raid boss event rewards without a related event page. Format using {{tl|Rewarded by header}} (edit '''introduction text''' here), {{tl|Rewarded by result format}} and {{tl|Rewarded by footer}}. == Usage == 
{{Rewarded by}}
{{Rewarded by|}}
{{Rewarded by||expandable=}}
{{Rewarded by|id=}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required. Name of the item. Defaults to PAGENAME. ;expandable : Optional. If set, then the multiple acquisition source lists are collapsed and can be expanded. ;style : Optional. CSS style for expandable sections. ;id : Optional. Item id, overrides unnamed parameter 1, used on item pages with several item variants. === Examples === 
{{Rewarded by|Eternal Ice Shard}}
{{Rewarded by|Eternal Ice Shard}}
